_note: Motion text standard, measured from references/motion-style-reference.mp4. render.py reads these values.

font._rule: Only this font and weight. Never switch font or weight for emphasis. Lean/italic is a shear on the letters, not the italic font.

colors._rule: Black and white only. No accent color, no outline, no shadow.

layout.position: centered horizontally and vertically, single line
layout.casing: keep the text as written (mostly lowercase, capital only where the sentence has one)

rhythm.cut: hard cuts between shots, no crossfades
rhythm.climaxPace: one word every half beat (about 0.2 s) for fast imperative runs

moves.punch: Hard cut in at about 165% scale, snaps to 100% in about 5 frames, then shrinks very slowly while held. Default entry.
moves.cut: Plain hard cut with a tiny 8% punch. For fast runs of short words.
moves.build: A phrase builds word by word on one line, each new word wiped in left to right, the line staying centered.
moves.karaoke: The whole phrase is on screen in gray; the word being said turns white, one after another.
moves.letters: The word slides in slightly from the right while its letters turn from gray to white, left to right.
moves.wipe: The word is revealed by a mask moving left to right.
moves.invert: Cut to a white background with dark text that darkens from light gray. Variants: track (letter spacing opens up) and skew (the end of the word leans and straightens).

exits.cut: Next shot replaces it instantly. Default.
exits.slide: Accelerates to the right and dims to dark gray in the last 0.2 s.
exits.wipe: A mask hides it from left to right in the last 0.12 s.
